name: Ansible
description: Ansible is an agentless IT automation tool for configuration management, application deployment, and infrastructure orchestration. It connects over SSH and, with the community.general proxmox_pct_remote connection plugin, can manage LXC containers through their Proxmox host.

notes.text: The generated SSH public key is displayed at the end of installation. Add it to /home/ansible/.ssh/authorized_keys on each Proxmox host.
Retrieve the public key at any time with: cat /root/.ssh/id_ed25519.pub
